title: Дослідницьке твердження
fields_and_relations: scope=research, statement, докази, альтернативи й авторство.
required_interaction: Сформувати твердження/передати пропозицію; машинний висновок до review не accepted.

implementation.view_model: Private versioned assertions, exact multiple supports/contradicts/context evidence, quotes and annotation anchors, concept relations, immutable history and separate human review of computational candidates
limitations: Local descriptive counts and manual comparison; no inferential statistics, external AI model or shared editing. Research interpretations are not accepted archival descriptions or vocabulary mappings.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store v9; additive synthetic analysis example and preserved existing grants/data
permissions: research.write in an explicit archive grant
domain.read rechecked for every source, note, assertion, citation and download
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, compare expected corpus/assertion revision, mutate clone, validate exact FK/versions and immutable corpus membership hashes, commit once.
